mentions.name: ChatMyCal
mentions.description: This app extracts schedules from pasted emails, photos, or PDF handouts and publishes them as subscribe-able calendars. It acts as an AI-powered calendar editor, supporting batch edits, coordinated event icons, and rules applied to all events, and can also generate full schedules such as a monthly book club or a weekend foodie trip. Calendars can be transferred to a group admin to share with others.
mentions.problem: When you receive an email or handout with a massive schedule - in text, image or PDF - you have to hand re-enter dozens of events.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I built https://www.chatmycal.com/
